title: Yilun Chen
text:
Yilun Chen 陈逸伦


Assistant Professor School of Data Science, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen


 chenyilun at cuhk dot edu dot cn  322b Daoyuan Building  Google Scholar








About


I am an Assistant Professor in the School of Data Science at the Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen. I received my Ph.D. in Operations Research from Cornell University in 2021, advised by David A. Goldberg. Before joining CUHK-Shenzhen, I was a postdoctoral researcher at Columbia Business School, working with Yash Kanoria. I hold a B.S. in Mathematics from Yuanpei College, Peking University.




Research


My research is in Operations Research, with interests at the intersection of economics, theoretical computer science, and statistics. I study sequential decision-making under uncertainty, online resource allocation, dynamic matching, and algorithmic/mechanism design questions that arise in platforms and marketplaces.




Selected Awards



2024 INFORMS Junior Faculty Interest Group Best Paper Award


2024 Chinese Scholars Association for Management Science and Engineering Best Paper Award


2024 INFORMS RMP Jeff McGill Student Paper Award, awarded to Akshit Kumar
